The structure of Rb₂AuPt crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—two Rb, two Au, and four Pt—distributed across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Au centers with 9 neighbors (3 Au, 6 Pt) and Pt centers with 10 neighbors (4 Au, 6 Rb), while Rb centers have 12 neighbors (6 Au, 6 Pt) in a close-packed-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Au 9-vertex and Pt 10-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner, edge, and face sharing between Au and Rb polyhedra.
